title: Operator persona
summary: A bounded fleet operator in the existing persona team: 25 journal-derived situations with current code and gap evidence, explicit role and permission boundaries, a paired human/shadow record before operational effects, measured promotion, and thirteen dependency-ordered implementation slices.

openDecisions.question: Role
openDecisions.options: A keep manual journal; B bounded fleet-operator persona; C autonomous Admin.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Normal persona and case coordinator, with existing dispatcher, guardian, manager and acceptance owners.

openDecisions.question: Authority
openDecisions.options: A inherit Admin; B narrow capability and host/project grants; C read-only forever.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Start with observe, record and publish. Add individually reviewed T1 families; exact-request T2 stays with the Owner. No self-issued grants.

openDecisions.question: Shadow review
openDecisions.options: A time only; B time plus family-specific evidence; C agreement percentage alone.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: At least seven days, thirty prospective cases, five per candidate family, 90 percent complete provenance, zero unsafe eligible advice and 90 percent useful recommendations/correct deferrals. Owner decides family promotion; quiet families stay shadow.

openDecisions.question: Budget
openDecisions.options: A use spare subscription freely; B capped allowance within the persona pool; C no diagnostic model.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: 60,000 tokens/week; seven five-minute ordinary sessions and one fifteen-minute investigation. Model-free hot path. Existing card-first and workspace limits prevail.

openDecisions.question: First operational family
openDecisions.options: A automatic acceptance and global tuning; B after-settlement feedback/diagnostic request; C all host actions first.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Build one idempotent continuation handler, closed by default, with new evidence, current brief/attempt and existing recovery-owner checks. Ordinary acceptance remains on its current rail.

openDecisions.question: Settings experiments
openDecisions.options: A autonomous multivariable tuning; B one-field confirmed experiments; C no tuning.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: One active experiment per project, target-context proof, saved baseline/revision, fixed cohort and stop/rollback rules. Start with batch deadline before other timing fields or stacking. Rollback needs its approved authority too.

openDecisions.question: Deploy and host work
openDecisions.options: A arbitrary shell and cleanup; B typed plans with protected references; C manual host work forever.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Canary and rollout outcome evidence first. One classifier-bounded exact-artifact build retry can later be delegated. Cleanup initially stays a confirmed human runbook, protecting active/current plus two rollback releases and referenced evidence.

openDecisions.question: Evidence retention
openDecisions.options: A rely on 72-hour events; B durable cases with bounded detail; C retain all raw logs.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Retain sanitized case detail and revisions for 90 days, weekly aggregate outcomes for 52 weeks, and decision/audit references under existing audit policy. Store receipt ids and small redacted excerpts, never tokens or whole host logs. A legal hold follows existing authority.

openDecisions.question: Unavailable hardware
openDecisions.options: A waive silently; B disabled/unverified capability plus manual probe after owner scope decision; C leave every dependent card blocked.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Record missing capability, owner choice and the manual validation requirement. Never label unsupported hardware tested. Persona drafts; Owner changes the acceptance scope.

openDecisions.question: Response and requests
openDecisions.options: A model on every poll; B model-free collector with explicit owner requests; C weekly reports only.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Consume the existing event stream, reconcile at start/cursor gap and at least each minute while active. Persist new advice within ten seconds of a fresh event when sources are ready. Authority-blocked fleet cases request the Owner immediately, remind once after thirty minutes if still unacknowledged, then include them in the daily pending list. Missing source facts remain explicit.

openDecisions.question: Evaluation
openDecisions.options: A maximize quota and agreement; B useful delivery, cost and safety with denominators; C a single weighted rank immediately.
openDecisions.recommendation: B: Report measured rates, comparable cohorts, own cost, misses and disagreements. No invented savings and no aggregate operator rank until measurements are trustworthy.

## Entry points
backend/Features/Operator/OperatorCoordinationStore.cs, OperatorLogEndpoints.cs; task-server operator-log authority/proxy patterns; docs/app/schemas/.

## Deliver
Add the versioned append-only case, frozen snapshot, advice, actual-action and outcome record described under Shadow mode. Add scoped create/read/append APIs and a deterministic JSON comparison export. Support manual advice and human receipts without a persona or a model. Pair by case/occurrence and subject generation; require explicit linking when ambiguous. Preserve retrospective provenance and unknown fields. Project-filter every read, redact secret-shaped text, fence appends by expected case revision and client idempotency key, and keep remote Task Server authority when configured. Project a human-readable reference into the existing operator log rather than overloading free text as the machine record. Apply 90-day detail retention without deleting decision/audit authority records. No product-wide UI is needed.

## Acceptance
- A complete manually entered advice -> human action -> outcome is exportable from the API on the first slice.
- Duplicate appends are idempotent, conflicting revisions return 409, and restart retains record order.
- Cross-project access is refused; redaction and missing receipts are explicit.
- Retrospective entries cannot be marked prospective, and no operational effect is called.

## Scope
No detectors, model calls, new operational grants, UI, setting changes or live effects. This slice must deliver the shadow record independently of later slices.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Family-specific live admission and rollback

Source: docs/operator-persona/index.html and workbench.json (AGT-4056). Read this Dossier, the related role Dossiers, active AGENTS.md and the owning domain contracts first. Use the named Dossier recommendation as the working choice unless a recorded Owner decision selects another option; record the selected option in the delivery report. Do not wait for another approval of a recommended implementation choice. This card authorizes implementation, not live promotion or external operational actions. Keep source, tests and documentation scoped to this slice. Runtime stores are application-owned; use APIs for task changes and leave Git/worktree management to the platform. Add any new docs page to docs/start/README.md in this implementation change.

Working decisions: FO-D2 B, FO-D3 B, FO-D5 B.

## Entry points
Persona activation/stop-all and scoped standing grants; FO-5 family eligibility, FO-7 permits, FO-8 continuation and FO-11 build retry; existing gateway/profile/appliers.

## Deliver
Add Owner-only family enable/disable controls with a recorded evidence cohort, decision, expiry and specific operation scope. Default every family to shadow. Enforce seven days, thirty prospective cases, five per candidate family, 90 percent provenance, zero unsafe eligible advice and 90 percent useful/correct deferrals. A quiet or unmeasured family remains shadow. Add per-workspace four-effect/day and one-effect/case-without-new-facts ceilings with one active mutation per card/host; respect tighter platform limits. Gate approved continuation and artifact retry through existing authority and keyed appliers. Settings and deploy remain confirmed; cleanup remains a human plan. Any serious safety miss closes the affected family, preserving evidence and other scoped observations. Ship mechanisms and tests only; do not enable a real installation in this card.

## Acceptance
- Insufficient, retrospective or incomplete cohorts cannot enable a live family.
- Duplicate/restarted/unknown-result requests are reconciled, revoked grants and stop-all close admission, and Owner takeover supersedes a pending effect.
- Family rollback preserves case and audit history and never broadens another grant.
- UI controls have real permission checks plus light/dark Playwright evidence; both transition-boundary suites pass.

## Scope
No broad Admin mode, autonomous acceptance, new dispatcher, guardian or task-workspace engine. Live operation still requires a recorded Owner grant after delivery.
